title: Authority Boundary — Industry Pressure
prompt: Instrumental only. An original restrained chamber-string tension cue for an analytical editorial documentary. Start almost weightless with one low cello long tone, small viola and violin ensemble held harmonics, a rare felt-piano note, and generous room air. Develop one continuous 112-second arc rather than a loop: 0–25 seconds quiet uncertainty with wide space; 25–60 seconds measured forward motion through slowly tightening harmony; 60–90 seconds fuller bow energy and a slightly wider string register as evidence accumulates; 90–112 seconds remove upper detail and release into an unresolved low cello. Tension must come from harmony and bow pressure, never from loudness or speed. Keep low-to-medium dynamics and leave room for narration. No vocals, no percussion, no ostinato, no repeated staccato pattern, no ticking, no horror, no trailer swell, no riser, no impact, no braam, no heroic climax, no sentimental melody, no abrupt change, no recognizable tune, and no imitation of a specific composer or film score.
